description:
The Israeli military has said it would open criminal investigations into the deaths of 9 people, including 5-year-old #HindRajab, who was killed in #Gaza in early 2024.
Rajab was trapped in a car under Israeli fire and made a desperate phone call pleading for help.
Her final phone call inspired the award-winning film The Voice of Hind Rajab.
title: Israel says to open criminal probes into killings of child and medics in Gaza

description: Amid sweltering conditions in central China's Wuhan, a centralized river-water cooling system is helping to cool a primary school and a commercial complex. Currently servicing about 260,000 square meters of building space, the project is expected to eventually provide air conditioning across more than 2.1 million square meters.
title: China's Wuhan turns to Yangtze River for cooling solutions

author: New China TV
description:
Located in the mountainous terrain of southwest China's Guizhou Province, the Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge, a steel-truss suspension bridge, is a key project on the Liuzhi-Anlong Expressway. It opened to traffic on Sept. 28, 2025. 
It has been certified by Guinness World Records (GWR) as the world's highest bridge, with a confirmed height of 626.01 meters. The bridge has also been developed as a tourism attraction. Since opening, its sightseeing elevators, high-altitude bungee jumping facilities, and water-curtain light shows have attracted large numbers of visitors. #Guizhou #Bridge #ChinaTravel
title: FlyOverChina | A drone's-eye view of the world's highest bridge

author: New China TV
description:
Former acrobat Wei Qing has taken the classic Chinese acrobatic act of the rolling ring to a new level. 
Handling a ring weighing more than 10 kg, she created an original performance blending dance, acrobatics and martial arts. 
Her unique act has taken her to audiences across China and earned her a large following on popular video-sharing platform Douyin.
title: Chinese acrobat turns 10-kilo rolling ring into dazzling art form
